As a Maintenance Employee, you will work on maintaining and repairing packaging for fragile high-tech components. You will follow clear instructions and work together with colleagues to ensure a safe and efficient production process.

Your tasks include:

- Repairing and inspecting packaging according to checklists and work instructions
- Performing preventive maintenance on packaging materials
- Working with hand tools and technical equipment
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Registering repairs and inspections in the system
- Loading, unloading, and transporting materials with an EPT or forklift
- Collaborating with colleagues to maintain quality and safety standards

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Week 1: 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: 15:00 – 00:00

The shifts alternate weekly.

During your onboarding period, you will receive extensive training and guidance to become familiar with the tasks and tools required for the role.

- Technical insight and a practical working attitude
- Experience with maintenance work and reading technical drawings
- Experience using hand tools and operating an EPT or forklift
- Forklift certificate is preferred or can be obtained through WerkTalent
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language (minimum B1 level)
- Accurate and independent working attitude

Do you enjoy taking control and ensuring everything runs smoothly? As a Print Production Worker, you'll be responsible for delivering print materials in perfect condition to our clients. From bundling and packing to cutting and folding, you'll tackle the work with enthusiasm.

Responsibilities:

- Bundling and packing print materials
- Cutting flyers, brochures, and folders
- Creating stapled brochures
- Folding various types of folders

- Good command of the English language
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team
- Living in the Etten-Leur area
- Own transport
- Available to work in 3shift system

As a Operator Food 2-shifts, you’ll be part of a lively team of over 30 colleagues in a modern production facility. Working in a 2-shift system, you’ll help oversee the entire production process — from raw materials to finished products. We produce a wide variety of peanut butter for a diverse customer base, so no two days are the same.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Operating and setting up production machines

- Troubleshooting minor technical issues

- Performing routine maintenance on equipment

- Checking finished products for quality and consistency

We do not provide accommodations. You need to live in the surroundings of Raamsdonkveer.

You will work in 2 shifts from 6:00 to 14:15 and from 14:00 to 22:15.

Requirements for working as a Operator Food 2-shifts:

- You’ve already worked in a production environment

- You know how to solve little technical issues on the production line

- Willingness to work in a production environment (including exposure to food products)

- Basic understanding of English or Dutch

- Willingness to help your co-workers on the production line

If you are looking for a job where you can work part-time or full-time, we have the perfect option for you! Join us now as a production employee at Kuehne + Nagel in Zaandam. Working in a close team and a lot of varied work sounds good, doesn't it! And all that for a nice salary of € 14,99! Do you work in the weekend or evenings? Then there are also extra  allowances for the evening and night. Work hard, and you might get a permanent contract at Kuehne + Nagel after just 10 weeks!

We dot not provide housing. If you are EU-citizen and need accommodation you can apply here:
https://www.tempo-team.nl/vacatures?specialtype=euflex

Apply now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions, so that we can help you quickly. Don't have WhatsApp? Then we will contact you by phone or e-mail!

What we offer
- Nice salary of €14,99 gross per hour
- Allowances up till 100%
- Salary increase every year
- Travel expenses
- Chance for a permanent contract after 10 weeks!
- Part-time or full-time job. You choose!

Who you are
As a production employee, you are available at least 3 days a week. Besides that it is important that you meet the following requirements;

- You are 18 years or older
- You speak English or Dutch
- You can work at least 3 days during the week
- You can work in 3 shifts; 6:00-15:00 and 15:00-00:00 and 21:00 - 06:00
- You have your own accommodation in the area of Zaandam
- You are available to work for at least 2 months
- You have your own transporation

What will you do
Your day as production employee starts in the canteen, a chat with your colleagues and a game of table soccer to warm up for the working day! Your working day will be different every day, because you are all-round employable in the whole warehouse, so lots of variety! Kuehne + Nagel processes all returns coming back from the Albert Heijn. You can think of all packaging such as beer crates and plastic bottles. But also food that can no longer be sold in the stores.

Would you like to earn €14.99 per hour as a logistics associate? Want to sort items and build muscle while you work? 💪 Here, you’ll be sorting items for a well-known major retailer. You’ll work day shifts, so you’ll have your evenings free. Read on and apply now!

What we offer
- €14,99 per hour
- Fulltime, 32 hours is negotiable
- Dayshifts from 07:00-15:30
- Work in a fun, close-knit team
- Long-term job
- The evenings are yours!

Who you are
With your energetic work ethic and attention to detail, you’ll breeze through the warehouse! Together with a friendly team, you’ll roll up your sleeves to sort all the items. You must also meet the following requirements:

- You speak English or Dutch
- You can apply for VOG
- You can handle physically demanding work

What will you do
As a logistics associate, you’ll be responsible for sorting. This company sorts all the merchandise for a well-known retail chain—from clothing to jewelry and from suitcases to kitchen accessories. This means they no longer have to sort the items in the store. The pallets with crates are delivered to you. You’ll open each crate and then sort all the products. It’s your job to sort them by product group into separate crates. Shirts with the shirts and bags with the bags. You’ll use the barcode to determine which crate each item belongs in. That’s how you’ll sort all the products. In addition, you’ll attach security tags to the more expensive items and apply labels to some products. Thanks to your hard work, all they’ll have to do in the store is find a spot for them.

- Sort all the items by product group

Where will you work
You’ll be working at Kuehne + Nagel in Moerdijk. Kuehne + Nagel isn’t just any transportation and logistics company—it’s a world-renowned name! And let’s not forget, it’s a company with a great atmosphere.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Reading technical drawings and following work instructions.
- Inspecting wooden components for quality and damage.
- Reporting production deviations and quality issues.
- Working safely with hand tools and power tools.
- Supporting colleagues within the woodworking department.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Monday to Friday: 06:00 – 15:00
- Monday to Friday: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- mbo working and thinking level.
- Experience with woodworking or assembly work.
- Ability to read technical drawings.
- Technical insight and a hands-on mentality.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Good command of the English language.

For a leading high-tech company in Eindhoven, we are looking for an accurate and motivated Cleanroom Precision Operator. In this role, you are responsible for processing valuable industrial components in a controlled cleanroom environment where quality, precision, and safety are the highest priorities.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to strict cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly and packaging activities using approved materials and tools.
- Inspecting products with measuring equipment and carrying out quality checks.
- Reading and following technical drawings and detailed work instructions.
- Registering inspection results and production data in the quality system.
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process.
- Keeping the cleanroom and workplace clean, safe, and organized.

Working hours

You will work Monday through Friday in day shifts between 07:00 and 18:00.

- Minimum of 1 year experience in cleanroom, production, or assembly work
- Good command of the English language
- Ability to read and understand technical drawings
- Accurate and independent working attitude
- Willingness to work according to strict procedures and quality guidelines

Preferred

- Experience cleaning high-tech components
- Experience with quality measurements and measuring equipment

As an operator, your main responsibility is to oversee the packaging of mangoes and avocados according to customer specifications. Subsequently, these yields are dispatched to supermarkets. Within this role, you will operate machinery and also supervise production staff working alongside you on the line. You will do this in English.

- Set up and adjust the net clipper or flowpack machines (performing light technical tasks).
- Supervise production workers.
- Ensure the smooth operation of the production line.
- Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise.
- Perform administrative tasks on a computer to ensure all records and registrations are accurately maintained.
- Perform additional production tasks and maintain line cleanliness.

This is a full-time day shift position starting at 6:45 AM, concluding around 4:00 PM, with the possibility of extending hours for which you will receive a 135% overtime bonus after 38 hours worked per week. Weekends are off. However, it's important to note that the work environment is cold, with a temperature of 10 degrees Celsius, and you will be provided with appropriate warm clothing.

- Experience as an operator in an AGF environment, preferably with experience in using a net clipper or flowpack machine.
- Good command of the Dutch or English language.
- Leadership qualities.
- Full-time availability, preference for a permanent position.
- Own transportation is essential.
- Living near the Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk area.

As a Cleaning Operator, you will work in a high-tech production environment in Eindhoven, where industrial packaging and transport boxes are cleaned, inspected, and prepared for reuse. This is a full-time position in a 2-shift schedule within an international organization with long-term career opportunities.

Function Description

As a Cleaning Operator, you are responsible for cleaning and preparing high-tech packaging materials according to strict quality standards and work instructions. You play an important role in ensuring that industrial packaging is ready for safe worldwide transport.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Cleaning industrial packaging and transport boxes according to work instructions.
- Removing labels, contamination, and transport damage from packaging.
- Cleaning and packing packaging materials and components.
- Working according to cleanroom and logistics procedures.
- Reading English checklists and technical work instructions.
- Reporting quality deviations and process irregularities.
- Operating an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck) or stacker.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday, 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday, 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance, which is included in the stated monthly salary.

Saturday work may occasionally be required in consultation. Hours worked on Saturdays are paid with a 50% allowance on top of your regular hourly wage.

Must-haves

- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Good command of the Dutch and/or English language.
- Affinity with cleaning and production work.
- Willingness to work occasional Saturdays when required.

Nice to have

- Experience as an assembly worker, production worker, or logistics employee.
- Experience operating an EPT or stacker.
- Living in or within easy travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard.

- Registering internal orders correctly in the logistics system.
- Keeping the warehouse and workplace clean, safe, and organized.
